teacher_info.introduction: I am a certified English teacher with experience teaching general English, conversational English, business English, and exam preparation. If you are looking to improve your English speaking skills for personal reasons or to pass a proficiency exam, I can help you! I have worked with students preparing for both Trinity and Cambridge proficiency exams, and I am familiar with the language goals and structures of these tests. My lessons are very relaxed, but they are also challenging. I love the English language, and I try to help you see the beauty of it too, even while preparing for exams or brushing up on your skills for work. I choose material which will interest you, and I try to teach language which you will find useful for your circumstances. I am also a language student, and my experiences as a student have shown me what a good lesson is. I like my lessons to be full of authentic language which I will actually use when I go abroad. While grammar is important, I like a small bit of grammar at the beginning of the lesson and plenty of time to practice using it. This is how I run my lessons, offering lots of time for students to practice, receive correction, try again, and build their confidence in communicating in English. I hold a TEFL certificate and a BA in English with a concentration in creative writing.
